name: ComputeWordSumsAndSetFlag
summary: Sums three strided u16 ranges at self+0x8c/0xa8/0x28c (stride 4) and stores (sumA <= sumB>>2) as a byte at +0x1c

fields.type: uint16_t word_8c (u16 read, stride 4, 7 entries: +0x8c..+0xa4, accumulated into
fields.name: sumA)

fields.type: uint16_t word_a8 (u16 read, stride 4, 121 entries: +0xa8..+0x288, accumulated into
fields.name: sumB)

fields.type: uint16_t word_28c (u16 read, stride 4, 128 entries: +0x28c..+0x488, accumulated into
fields.name: sumA)
